text:
Ava: Quick ask-the-room: what's your go-to comfort gif or meme when the day goes sideways? Drop links or describe it.
Marco: The 'this is fine' dog but with a tiny cup of espresso added. :coffee:
Li: Kermit sipping tea but it's actually matcha. Calm chaos.
Zoe: A baby Yoda faceplant gif. Instant reset.
tom: That tiny owl nodding. Somehow very validating.
Ava: Love it. Bonus points if it doubles as an approval reaction.
Marco: I keep a folder called 'mood-savers' in Drive. Should we start a shared one?
Li: Yes please. Would be great for onboarding newbies too.
snack-bot: Snack poll reminder: do you prefer salty or sweet for Friday? React :one: salty :two: sweet
Zoe: :two: sweet all the way
Ava: :one: salty but I'll accept chocolate bribes
Marco: I'll add my 'this is fine + espresso' to the shared folder if someone creates it.
Ava: I'll create the folder and drop a few classics. Title idea: 'Emergency Memes & Gifs'.
Li: Can we add a short note for when to use each? Like 'use sparingly for catastrophic CI failures'.
tom: Also gifs for "meeting could have been an email" scenarios. Very niche.
Ava: Good category. I will seed with Kermit, Baby Yoda, 'this is fine', tiny owl, and a triumphant cat.
Zoe: I nominate tom for curator of 'triumpant cat' subfolder.
tom: Accepting the solemn duty.
